lines.text: 2Urban Settlements
Pakistan has an old history of urban settlement. The population of urban areas or cities is
increasing due to various functions of human interest including economic opportunities (Jobs,
trade etc.) public facilities (health, education and postal services) and proper infrastructure.
Urban settlement in Pakistan can be categorizedon thebasisof time, locationandfunction.
Urban settlement
Ancient city-Pakistan isknown forits ancient civilization likeIndus and Harappa civilization.
o Peshawar, Taxila, Multan, Thatta, Sahiwal (Harappa) are the examples of ancient cities.
Mohenjo-Daro isone of the largest settlements of the Indus valleyand one of the worldearliest
major urban settlements. The civilization existed from 2500 B.C. to 1500B.C. Now it has been
declaredaUNESCoWorldHeritagesitein1980.
o Modern city - Islamabad is an example of modern and planned city. It is built under a
masterplan.
Administrative city/town-The cities performing administrative works (state offices,ministries
etc.)are known as an administrative city.All the provincial capitals and federal capital are
consideredadministrativecities.Forexample,Karachi, Lahore,PeshawarandQuetta.
o Industrial city/Town - The cities that developed because of industrial growth. Karachi is the
main industrial and port city of Pakistan located on Arabian sea. Other main industrials cities
are Faisalabad, Sialkot, Gujranwala, Lahore, Hyderabad, Hattar and Hub.
o Mining city/town-Khewera isa major example of mining city in Pakistan.
Educational city-Some cities of Pakistan arefamousfor providing best educational facilities
and have become educational centers. For example Karachi, Lahore, Peshawar and Islamabad.
Lahore is alsoknown as city ofcolleges,
